limitations: An infinite base value invalidates the literal abstract openness guarantee — Counterevidence: Finite convergence is a plausible intended reading. The actual Mrel_X(0) is finite by Lemma 3.59, and Mjrel(0) converges by Proposition 4.16.
An infinite base value invalidates the literal abstract openness guarantee — Limit: This is not an independent proof of all quoted pluripotential inputs.

Incorrect small-parameter integrability in the auxiliary Fano-type proof — Limit: No claim that all resolutions are of Fano type.
The target polytope for log-concavity — Counterevidence: An unqualified global reading of Corollary B avoids the gap; the example does not prove absence of an extremal metric.
